title: Accommodation
description: Make your rest last longer – warm, comfortable overnight stays for our sauna guests.

whiteSauna.title: White Sauna
whiteSauna.description: In the sauna building itself, always warm – even in the coldest winter months.

blackSauna.title: Grey Sauna
blackSauna.description: A separate building with a kitchen. A quiet, well-insulated room.

transport.title: Public Transport:
transport.description: By bus from Riga to the "Dzimtmisa" stop – we collect you there free of charge (choose it when booking). Or choose the transfer from Riga and back – €60 for up to 4 people, €120 for up to 8; for larger groups the price is agreed separately.
